title: Madison Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled just a stone's throw from the glistening Gulf waters, this exquisite four-bedroom, five-and-a-half bath haven boasts an inviting blend of modern luxury and homely warmth. Newly refurbished, every inch of the 3,000 sq ft. home resonates with meticulous attention to detail. From the lustrous hardwood floors that grace all three levels to the gourmet Viking kitchen adorned with granite countertops and dual kitchen islands, it's clear that no expense has been spared. And if the thought of whipping up a meal on the six-burner gas stove doesn't entice, perhaps the wet bar equipped with a wine cooler, sink, and ice maker will. The spacious first-floor design is bathed in natural light, welcoming large groups yet maintaining an intimate coziness perfect for smaller gatherings. The entertainment never ends with a brand-new 65" Smart TV, DVDs, games, and puzzles stationed at the built-in desk.
rooms_guidance: Third Floor Bedroom 4: Two Single Over Single Bunks + Three Doubles
